pathways.name: Coagulation Cascade
pathways.description: Plasma coagulation factors and fibrinolysis; a hub for cardiovascular and thrombotic disease.

pathways.name: JAK-STAT Signaling
pathways.description: Cytokine receptor signaling through JAK kinases and STAT transcription factors; a hub for inflammatory and autoimmune disease pathways.

pathways.name: Renin-Angiotensin System
pathways.description: Renin-angiotensin-aldosterone axis controlling blood pressure and fluid balance.

pathways.name: T Cell Receptor Signaling
pathways.description: TCR signal transduction and T cell activation; a therapeutic hub in autoimmunity.

pathways.name: TLR / Innate Sensing
pathways.description: Endosomal and surface Toll-like receptor signaling driving innate immune activation.

pathways.name: TNF Signaling
pathways.description: Tumor necrosis factor receptor superfamily signaling; central to many autoimmune and inflammatory diseases.

pathways.name: Type I Interferon Pathway
pathways.description: IFN-α/β production and signaling through IFNAR; drives the interferon gene signature in autoimmune disease.
